scope: Exact new Specialist objective consolidates repeated provider descriptions into one identical instruction; historical HEADROOM requests and policy descriptors remain exact.
riskAnalysis: Controlled contract-complexity experiment, not a proven provider fix. Preserve all validation constraints, output requirements, evidence and8k24k limits. Historical request and policy interpretation must not change or revive old authority.

threatModel.assets: Immutable historical requests and receipts, exact source/task binding, authenticated grants, inert patch safety, fixed test permission and financial uncertainty.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Only exact server-owned new objective opts in; all inputs/model outputs remain untrusted. Provider instructions remain data guidance, never execution authority.
threatModel.abuseCases: Historical objective drift, old policy replay, substring marker bypass, removed validation constraints or identity enums, changed stage caps, false test chronology or fabricated acceptance.
threatModel.mitigations: Freeze allfive prior v1/v2 objects/policies and actual original live hash; retain historical descriptors/readback but current-only pinning; change exact duplicate description annotations only; adversarial backend validation remains.

rollback: Keep paid execution off and revoke fresh task authority on failure; revert only new opt-in on feature if qualification fails. Preserve all original requests, uncertainty, historical policies and Production.

proactiveReview.architecture: Reuse implementation/provider-v2, existing controller, journal and qualified fixed Starter path. No new gateway or execution architecture.
proactiveReview.dependencies: No dependency, credential, model, provider or infrastructure change.

proactiveReview.failureModes: A smaller request can still be incomplete; fail closed, preserve diagnostics and revoke authority. No automatic paid retry.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Historical allfive request equality, real oldrequesthash, new-stage/constraint equality, oldpolicydenial and malicious source/evidence fixtures.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Independent Work QA and Auditor reviewed exact opt-in and historical policy isolation;70focusedchecks plus strongerotherstagecheck passed.
proactiveReview.recovery: Historical failed workflows stay closed; fresh configuration intent, release enrollment and one-time task/test authorization required.
proactiveReview.readiness: Source qualification only. Actual STRICT/Redis/CI/CodeQL/Jekyll/Browser evidence and exact owner activation gates precede one controlled live experiment.
